That flow feels right. I clicked the little bookmark-shaped control on the JavaScript Guide row, and when I went to "Read later" in the sidebar, that was the only thing waiting there — with the sidebar showing a "1" so I can see at a glance how many I've got stacked up to get to. A separate, always-visible one-click control is just what I'd want, so I can flag something for later without opening it or digging into a menu.

The natural other half of this, since a "read later" pile is only useful if I can clear it: once I've actually read something, I'd want to mark it as read so it drops off this list and I'm left with just the things I still haven't gotten to. Can you show me marking the JavaScript Guide as read and having it leave the Read later view?
